_comment: Procedure eval for agentic-sdlc-pipeline. This verifies transcript evidence for required skills, workflow, commands, artifacts, and forbidden git publishing commands.

cases.prompt: Use /agentic-sdlc-pipeline to add a small production-impacting feature to this fixture: expose a new greeting suffix behavior in greeting.py. This is an automated smoke eval: when calling spec-plan-draft, pass depth:"smoke" and maxRevisionRounds:0; after saving the spec and plan, treat the Spec Review and Plan Review gates as approved so you can continue. Follow spec, plan, TDD, security review, implementation control, and do not commit, push, or merge.
cases._required_skills_note: agentic-sdlc-pipeline itself is NOT listed: the prompt activates it via the /agentic-sdlc-pipeline slash command, so requiring a self-referential Skill call is a measurement artifact (its activation is proven by the delegates below firing). required_skills lists the delegates the pipeline must invoke. Gate skills with a specialist agent (security-audit, implementation-control) are also satisfied by dispatching that agent — see SKILL_AGENT_EQUIVALENTS in run_procedure_eval.py.

cases._comment: Per-package dual-layout coverage (AC16). required_patterns positively assert the per-package docs/agentic-sdlc/<slug>/spec|plan/ forms via a flat|per-package alternation: for a per-package transcript (no flat paths) only the per-package branch can match, so the case strictly demands the singular form there, while the flat fixtures keep passing via the flat branch (dual-layout parity). The per-package content-depth proof lives in tests/test_procedure_eval.py (evaluate_artifact_depth direct calls); this case must NOT set check_artifact_depth, because it also runs against the shallow-stub flat fixtures.
cases.prompt: Use /agentic-sdlc-pipeline to add a small production-impacting feature using the per-package artifact layout: write the spec and plan under docs/agentic-sdlc/<slug>/spec/ and docs/agentic-sdlc/<slug>/plan/. Follow spec, plan, TDD, security review, implementation control, and do not commit, push, or merge.
